preconditions.description: The number of employees is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= 9 and 1 <= b <= 9 and a != b for a, b in employees)
preconditions.description: Each employee's starting floor (a) and destination floor (b) are between 1 and 9 inclusive, and they are not the same.
The input contains exactly n employees in the order they arrived.

postconditions.description: The minimal time is a non-negative integer representing the total seconds required to deliver all employees.

postconditions.expression: all(employee in delivered for employee in employees)
postconditions.description: Every employee is delivered to their destination floor in the computed minimal time.

postconditions.expression: minimal_time == sum(1 for _ in elevator_movements) + sum(1 for _ in door_operations) + sum(len(employees_in) + len(employees_out) for employees_in, employees_out in door_operations)
postconditions.description: The minimal time is the sum of time spent moving the elevator (1 second per floor), opening doors (1 second per operation), and employees entering/exiting (1 second per employee).

postconditions.expression: all(employees_in == sorted([e for e in employees if e[0] == current_floor and e not in delivered and len(elevator) < 4], key=lambda x: employees.index(x)) for current_floor, employees_in, employees_out in door_operations)
postconditions.description: Employees enter the elevator in the order they arrived, respecting the company's rules, and only if there is space.

postconditions.expression: all(employees_out == [e for e in elevator if e[1] == current_floor] for current_floor, employees_in, employees_out in door_operations)
postconditions.description: Employees exit the elevator only when they reach their destination floor.
